nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(average(mysql.commands), WHERE command = 'insert') AS `Insert Commands`, filter(average(mysql.commands), WHERE command = 'select') AS `Select Commands`, filter(average(mysql.commands), WHERE command = 'update') AS `Update Commands`, filter(average(mysql.commands), WHERE command = 'delete') AS `Delete Commands` FROM Metric TIMESERIES auto
SELECT average(mysql.query.count) as 'Queries' FROM Metric  TIMESERIES auto
SELECT average(`mysql.query.slow.count`) as 'Slow queries' FROM Metric  TIMESERIES auto
SELECT latest(mysql.threads) AS 'Active Connections' FROM Metric WHERE kind = 'connected'
SELECT max(`mysql.connection.count`) as 'Max connections' FROM Metric TIMESERIES auto

widgets.title: Read and written InnoDB bytes per second

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(average(mysql.buffer_pool.operations), WHERE operation IN ('read_requests', 'reads', 'read_ahead', 'read_ahead_rnd')) AS `Total Read Operations`, filter(average(mysql.buffer_pool.operations), WHERE operation = 'write_requests') AS `Write Operations` FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'mysql.buffer_pool.operations' TIMESERIES auto

widgets.title: Received and sent bytes per second

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(average(mysql.client.network.io), WHERE direction = 'received') AS `Bytes Received`, filter(average(mysql.client.network.io), WHERE direction = 'sent') AS `Bytes Sent`, average(mysql.client.network.io) AS `Total Network IO` FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'mysql.client.network.io' TIMESERIES auto
